headline: FRENCH ACROBAT BLONDIN CROSSES NIAGARA GORGE ON TIGHTROPE
dispatch: Charles Blondin, the French acrobat, crossed the Niagara Gorge on a tightrope on Tuesday, completing the terrifying passage over the roaring chasm to the astonishment of thousands gathered on both banks. The rope, stretched some 1,100 feet above the churning river below, held firm as Blondin moved step by careful step to the American side. No man is reported to have attempted such a feat over these falls before.
answer: Blondin walks tightrope across Niagara Gorge, 1859
